question_stem: A planet has mass $M = 2.55 \times 10^{24}\text{ kg}$ and radius $R = 6.05 \times 10^6\text{ m}$. A satellite is in a circular orbit about the planet.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Define gravitational potential at a point.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the origin of the centripetal force on the satellite.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the gravitational field strength $g$ at the surface of the planet is $4.65\text{ N kg}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: The orbital radius of the satellite is $r = 2.65 \times 10^7\text{ m}$. Calculate the gravitational field strength at this orbital distance.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Show that the orbital period $T$ of the satellite is $18\text{ hours}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: State one similarity and one difference between gravitational potential and electric potential.
